div.head: III Atr 6.1
div.ab: Et omnis aduocatio et omne ordalium sit in curia regis.
⁊ ælc téam ⁊ ælc ordal beo on þæs kyninges byrig.
⁊ ælc téam ⁊ ælc ordal beo on þæs kyninges byrig.
And every vouching to warranty and every ordeal shall take place in a royal manor.
And every vouching to warranty and every ordeal is to take place in a royal borough.
Und jeder Gewährzug und jedes Ordal finde statt im königlichen [Gericht in reichsunmittelbarer] Stadt.
And let every vouching to warranty and every ordeal take place in the king's borough.
